_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "negocios" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "identificacion" TEXT NULL, "direccion" TEXT NULL, "telefono" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, "moneda" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DOP', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "usuarios" ("deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "negocio_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES negocios (id), "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "salt" TEXT NOT NULL, "rol" TEXT NOT NULL, "activo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("activo" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "licencias_cache" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "estado" TEXT NOT NULL, "clave_licencia" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha_activacion" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha_vencimiento" TEXT NULL, "ultima_validacion" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "configuraciones" ("clave" TEXT NOT NULL, "valor" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("clave"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categorias" ("deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "productos" ("deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "categoria_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categorias (id), "unidad" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unidad', "precio_compra" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "precio_venta" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "stock_actual" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "stock_minimo" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "activo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("activo" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "historial_precios" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "producto_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES productos (id), "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "precio_anterior" INTEGER NOT NULL, "precio_nuevo" INTEGER NOT NULL, "usuario_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), "fecha" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proveedores" ("deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "telefono" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movimientos_inventario" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "producto_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES productos (id), "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "cantidad" REAL NOT NULL, "stock_resultante" REAL NOT NULL, "motivo" TEXT NULL, "referencia_id" TEXT NULL, "usuario_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), "fecha" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "caja_sesiones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha_apertura" TEXT NOT NULL, "monto_apertura" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fecha_cierre" TEXT NULL, "monto_esperado" INTEGER NULL, "monto_contado" INTEGER NULL, "diferencia" INTEGER NULL, "monto_dejado_siguiente" INTEGER NULL, "usuario_apertura" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), "usuario_cierre" TEXT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), "estado" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "caja_movimientos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "caja_sesion_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES caja_sesiones (id), "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "monto" INTEGER NOT NULL, "motivo" TEXT NULL, "referencia_id" TEXT NULL, "usuario_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), "fecha" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "compras" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "proveedor_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES proveedores (id), "numero_factura" TEXT NULL, "foto_factura_path" TEXT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pagada_de_caja" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pagada_de_caja" IN (0, 1)), "estado" TEXT NOT NULL, "usuario_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), "fecha" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "compra_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "compra_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES compras (id), "producto_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES productos (id), "cantidad" REAL NOT NULL, "costo_unitario" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ventas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ganancia" INTEGER NOT NULL, "caja_sesion_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES caja_sesiones (id), "usuario_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), "estado" TEXT NOT NULL, "nota" TEXT NULL, "fecha" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "venta_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "venta_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ventas (id), "producto_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES productos (id), "cantidad" REAL NOT NULL, "precio_unitario" INTEGER NOT NULL, "costo_unitario" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gastos" ("deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "categoria" TEXT NOT NULL, "concepto" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha" TEXT NOT NULL, "monto" INTEGER NOT NULL, "caja_sesion_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES caja_sesiones (id), "usuario_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "empleados" ("deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "foto_path" TEXT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "cedula" TEXT NULL, "direccion" TEXT NULL, "telefono" TEXT NULL, "fecha_ingreso" TEXT NOT NULL, "activo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("activo" IN (0, 1)), "salario" INTEGER NULL, "frecuencia_pago" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pagos_empleados" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empleado_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES empleados (id), "fecha" TEXT NOT NULL, "monto" INTEGER NOT NULL, "periodo" TEXT NULL, "caja_sesion_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES caja_sesiones (id), "usuario_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "auditoria" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "usuario_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES usuarios (id), "accion" TEXT NOT NULL, "modulo" TEXT NOT NULL, "entidad_id" TEXT NULL, "datos_antes" TEXT NULL, "datos_despues" TEXT NULL, "fecha" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "respaldos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha" TEXT NOT NULL, "archivo" TEXT NOT NULL, "tamano_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "resultado" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_queue" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "tabla" TEXT NOT NULL, "registro_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operacion" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "estado" TEXT NOT NULL, "intentos" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_usuarios_username ON usuarios (username)
CREATE INDEX idx_productos_nombre ON productos (nombre)
CREATE INDEX idx_productos_categoria ON productos (categoria_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_historial_precios_producto ON historial_precios (producto_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_movimientos_producto ON movimientos_inventario (producto_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_movimientos_fecha ON movimientos_inventario (fecha)
CREATE INDEX idx_caja_movimientos_sesion ON caja_movimientos (caja_sesion_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_compras_fecha ON compras (fecha)
CREATE INDEX idx_ventas_fecha ON ventas (fecha)
CREATE INDEX idx_ventas_sesion ON ventas (caja_sesion_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_gastos_fecha ON gastos (fecha)
CREATE INDEX idx_pagos_empleado ON pagos_empleados (empleado_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_auditoria_fecha ON auditoria (fecha)
CREATE INDEX idx_auditoria_modulo ON auditoria (modulo)
CREATE INDEX idx_sync_estado ON sync_queue (estado)
